jobs.prompt: Opus review t0114-sec2 findings to fix. (1) MEDIUM: in tools/watch-cli.mjs buildOwnerActions.listItems maps inbox items to only id, kind, title, summary and projectId, dropping boardSafe, text and choices, so in production every decision (including board-safe ones and hand-build requests) is refused; the tests used ownerItemsFromBoardInbox so they missed it. Fix: listItems must use the same ownerItemsFromBoardInbox (tools/board-inbox.mjs) the tests use, so production and tests share one mapping. (2) LOW: tools/board-inbox.mjs truncates text/title (TITLE_MAX), id (80) and choices (9 x 40 chars) BEFORE the server's isProtectedTopic re-check, so a protected word past the cut could hide. Fix: when building owner items, compute protectedTopic = isProtectedTopic over the FULL untruncated journal event text, title, id, choice and every option (from tools/board-action-guard.mjs) and carry it as a boolean; tools/board-owner-actions.mjs refuses a decision when item.protectedTopic !== false (missing means refuse) OR the re-check on the visible fields hits OR boardSafe !== true; truncation stays for display only. TESTS: add to tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs an end-to-end test that starts the REAL board server in remote mode the way the CLI does (createBoardApi/startBoardServer in tools/watch-cli.mjs with a temp project whose journal holds: a decision raised with boardSafe true and harmless text, a hand-build request decision, an unmarked decision, and a boardSafe decision whose text is 300 characters of harmless words followed by 'merge to main'), then through HTTP with the owner identity and header token: the harmless board-safe decision and the hand-build request can be prepared and approved (audit shows approved); the unmarked one and the long-text merge one are refused with decision-not-board-safe and no approved audit entry. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/board-owner-routes.test.mjs tests/board-action-guard-unit.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-handlers.test.mjs tests/board-owner-actions-ui.test.mjs tests/decision-board-safe.test.mjs tests/board-inbox.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
